_usage: Setup context for the nested-autonomy skill. Claude fills these at setup (SKILL.md 5-step flow) via AskUserQuestion, then COPIES this file to <plugin_data_dir>/config.json. Replace every PLACEHOLDER value. Validate: jq . config.json. Helpers read fields via: jq -r '.work_unit.cmd' config.json, jq -r '.gates[].assert' config.json, jq -r '.models.brain' config.json.

_help.task_name: Short slug for this unattended run; used in tmux session names, log filenames, and scar entries. No spaces.
_help.sandbox_path: Absolute path to the container/dir the whole unattended run is scoped to. Nothing outside this path is touched; /freeze + careful-guard hook key off it.
_help.work_unit.cmd: The Tier-3 job: the single work-unit command line (one training/batch/eval step) launched by lib/launch_worker.sh.
_help.work_unit.checkpoint_dir: Dir where the work unit writes resumable checkpoints. Ground-truth for progress detection (newest ckpt mtime) and crash resume.
_help.work_unit.resume: Flag/command appended to cmd to resume from the latest checkpoint after a crash (e.g. --resume-from <latest>). Empty string if the job is idempotent/restart-from-scratch.
_help.gates: Ordered verification gates. Each {id,name,assert}. The run is done only when EVERY gate's assert exits 0. Never eyeball; assert is the proof.
_help.gates[].id: Stable machine id for the gate; referenced in STATUS.md rows and scars.md. Keep stable across runs.
_help.gates[].name: Human label shown in logs and STATUS.md.
_help.gates[].assert: Gate predicate passed verbatim to lib/assert_gate.sh; exit 0 = pass, non-zero (incl. exit-2 INDETERMINATE) = NOT passed. Forms: 'file-nonempty <path>' | 'state-changed <path>' | 'marker <file> <token>' | 'metric>=<thresh> <cmd-printing-number>' | 'session-dead <tmux-name>' | 'no-gpu-orphans <pattern>' | 'cmd <shell...>' (generic: passes iff the shell command exits 0).
_help.models.orchestrator: Frontier model for the Tier-1 monitor/orchestrator brain (highest capability; runs rarely, decides big moves).
_help.models.brain: Cheap, fast model passed to `claude -p --model <here>` for the Tier-2 driver loop. Runs every cycle, so cost matters most here.
_help.models.batch: Model id for Tier-3 batch/offline jobs when the work unit itself calls an LLM. May equal models.brain.
_help.supervisor.cycle_s: Seconds the Tier-2 supervisor sleeps between cycles. Cache-aware pacing: large enough not to spin, small enough to catch crashes.
_help.supervisor.max_cycles: Hard cap on supervisor cycles before forced stop. Cost/runaway guard.
_help.supervisor.idle_stop: Stop the supervisor after this many CONSECUTIVE no-progress cycles (checkpoint mtime unchanged). 0 disables.
_help.batch_concurrency_cap: Max parallel Tier-3 workers. Keep <=3 to avoid GPU/RAM thrash and orphan storms.
_help.plugin_data_dir: Where cross-run memory (scars.md) and the active config copy live. Default ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-./.nested-autonomy}.
_help.done_marker: Token written to STATUS.md when all gates pass. Monitors and lib/restart_supervisor.sh gate on its presence. Default ALL-GATES-PASSED.
